verdict.rationale: Reducto publishes a machine-readable OpenAPI spec on its docs site and multi-language code examples (Python, Node.js, Go, cURL), so there is a first-party API reference with copy-paste examples. Nothing in the evidence shows the reference is interactive or that examples can be run in-browser; Studio's document testing is a separate workflow feature and isn't credited here. missing for 10: evidence of an interactive try-it/playground API reference, runnable in-docs examples, independent or hands-on corroboration

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can explore an interactive API reference with runnable examples
